title: Not a cube, but a regular large storage bag
text: Not a cube, but a regular large storage bag. This is not cubed at all. It is a large bag that has a pleat in the bottom to expand, but not to a cube. I really needed a cubed bag for my towels and for storage space. It would be perfect for a queen or king comforter. It doesn't look anything like the photo outside the bag it came in. It's flat, long and pleated in the bottom. It's like a regular jumbo storage bag
